levels.name: Diagnostic Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate SecurityDiag itself before trusting security evidence.

levels.name: Target & Security Context
levels.purpose: Resolve repository, Git state, safety mode, release phase and configured security targets.

levels.name: Repository Secrets & Artifact Hygiene
levels.purpose: Detect tracked secrets, private keys, sensitive env files and risky deployment artifacts without copying secret values.

levels.name: Supply Chain, Capsule Integrity & Automation
levels.purpose: Review dependency pinning, CI/container supply chain, Capsule Manager signed-artifact policy and declared dependency audits.

levels.name: Application Production Security
levels.purpose: Inspect Konnaxion production configuration, Django security controls and compose exposure.

levels.name: Clean Host & OS Baseline
levels.purpose: Establish remote host identity, OS state, time sync and pending update evidence.

levels.name: SSH Hardening
levels.purpose: Verify effective SSH authentication and forwarding policy.

levels.name: Firewall & Listening Ports
levels.purpose: Verify host firewall evidence and ensure internal service ports are not bound publicly.

levels.name: Docker & Capsule Runtime Policy
levels.purpose: Check Docker privilege boundaries, dangerous mounts/namespaces, image allowlists and published ports against Konnaxion runtime policy.

levels.name: Runtime Isolation, Agent & Security Gate
levels.purpose: Correlate runtime services with Capsule Manager Agent trust boundaries, network profile and exported Security Gate evidence.

levels.name: Secrets & Filesystem Permissions
levels.purpose: Verify sensitive remote paths and SSH material are not broadly readable.

levels.name: Persistence & Incident IOC Scan
levels.purpose: Look for known compromise indicators, suspicious persistence and executable artifacts in temporary areas.

levels.name: External TLS & Attack Surface
levels.purpose: Probe configured public endpoints, TLS, redirects, security headers and forbidden public TCP ports.

levels.name: Backup & Recovery Evidence
levels.purpose: Verify recent backup evidence and require an explicit isolated restore-drill attestation for release.

levels.name: Security Release Gate
levels.purpose: Combine SecurityDiag evidence with Capsule Manager Security Gate evidence and human recovery attestations.

repo.description: Repository, supply-chain and application production-security checks.

host.description: Remote VPS baseline through runtime, secrets and IOC checks.

incident.description: Remote host access, Docker and persistence/IOC evidence for incident recovery.

predeploy.description: Local repository + clean-host checks before application deployment.
